hope: Spend 3 Hope to transform into a Beastform without marking a Stress; choose one trait to raise by +1 until you drop out of it.

features.name: Beastform
features.short: Mark a Stress to transform into a creature of your tier or lower from the Beastform list (see SRD for the forms); drop out at any time or when you mark your last Hit Point. While transformed you can’t use weapons or cast domain card spells (spells already cast persist; you can still use other features and talk normally). You gain the Beastform’s features, add its Evasion bonus, and attack with its trait. Your armor becomes part of your body: mark Armor Slots as usual; they stay marked when you drop out.

features.name: Wildtouch
features.short: Perform harmless, subtle nature effects at will (grow a flower, a gust of wind, a campfire).

druid.warden-of-the-elements.name: Elemental Incarnation
druid.warden-of-the-elements.short: Mark a Stress to Channel an element until you take Severe damage or next rest (see the Elements table on the domain card sheet).

rows.name: Fire
rows.short: Adversaries in Melee range that damage you take 1d10 magic damage.

rows.name: Earth
rows.short: Add your Proficiency to your damage thresholds.

rows.name: Water
rows.short: When you damage an adversary in Melee range, all others within Very Close range mark a Stress.

druid.warden-of-the-elements.name: Elemental Aura
druid.warden-of-the-elements.short: Once per rest while Channeling, assume an aura affecting targets within Close range until Channeling ends (see the Elements table).

rows.name: Fire
rows.short: Adversaries that mark Hit Points also mark a Stress.

rows.name: Water
rows.short: When an adversary damages you, mark a Stress to move them anywhere within Very Close range of where they are.

rows.name: Air
rows.short: When you or an ally takes damage from an attack beyond Melee range, reduce it by 1d8.

druid.warden-of-the-elements.name: Elemental Dominion
druid.warden-of-the-elements.short: While Channeling, gain your element’s benefit (see the Elements table).

rows.name: Fire
rows.short: +1 Proficiency for attacks and spells that deal damage.

rows.name: Earth
rows.short: When you would mark Hit Points, roll a d6 per Hit Point; each 6 reduces the number marked by 1.

rows.name: Water
rows.short: When an attack against you succeeds, mark a Stress to make the attacker temporarily Vulnerable.

druid.warden-of-renewal.name: Clarity of Nature
druid.warden-of-renewal.short: Once per long rest, create a space of natural serenity within Close range. After a few minutes resting there, clear Stress equal to your Instinct, split as you choose between you and allies.

druid.warden-of-renewal.name: Regeneration
druid.warden-of-renewal.short: Touch a creature and spend 3 Hope: it clears 1d4 Hit Points.

druid.warden-of-renewal.name: Regenerative Reach
druid.warden-of-renewal.short: Regeneration can target creatures within Very Close range.

druid.warden-of-renewal.name: Warden’s Protection
druid.warden-of-renewal.short: Once per long rest, spend 2 Hope to clear 2 Hit Points on 1d4 allies within Close range.

druid.warden-of-renewal.name: Defender
druid.warden-of-renewal.short: In Beastform, when an ally within Close range marks 2 or more Hit Points, mark a Stress to reduce the number they mark by 1.

agile-scout.name: Agile
agile-scout.short: Silent movement; spend a Hope to move to Far range without rolling.

agile-scout.name: Fragile
agile-scout.short: Major or greater damage drops you out of Beastform.

household-friend.name: Companion
household-friend.short: Helping an Ally: roll a d8 as your advantage die.

household-friend.name: Fragile
household-friend.short: Major or greater damage drops you out of Beastform.

nimble-grazer.name: Elusive Prey
nimble-grazer.short: On a hit against you, mark a Stress and roll a d4; add it to your Evasion against that attack.

nimble-grazer.name: Fragile
nimble-grazer.short: Major or greater damage drops you out of Beastform.

pack-predator.name: Hobbling Strike
pack-predator.short: On a Melee hit, mark a Stress to make the target temporarily Vulnerable.

pack-predator.name: Pack Hunting
pack-predator.short: Hit the same target an ally just acted against: add a d8 to your damage roll.

aquatic-scout.name: Fragile
aquatic-scout.short: Major or greater damage drops you out of Beastform.

stalking-arachnid.name: Venomous Bite
stalking-arachnid.short: On a Melee hit, the target is temporarily Poisoned (1d10 direct physical damage each time they act).

stalking-arachnid.name: Webslinger
stalking-arachnid.short: Spin webs strong enough to support one creature; succeed on a Finesse Roll to temporarily Restrain a target within Close range.

armored-sentry.name: Armored Shell
armored-sentry.short: Resistance to physical damage. Mark an Armor Slot to retract into your shell: physical damage is further reduced by your Armor Score, but you can’t act until you leave the shell.

armored-sentry.name: Cannonball
armored-sentry.short: Mark a Stress: an ally throws you at a target within Close range (their Agility or Strength attack). On a hit, d12+2 physical damage using their Proficiency; spend a Hope to also hit a second target within Very Close range for half damage.

powerful-beast.name: Rampage
powerful-beast.short: Roll a 1 on a damage die: roll a d10 and add it. Before an attack, mark a Stress for +1 Proficiency on that attack.

mighty-strider.name: Carrier
mighty-strider.short: Carry up to two willing allies when you move.

mighty-strider.name: Trample
mighty-strider.short: Mark a Stress to move up to Close range in a line, attacking all targets within Melee range of it; hits deal d8+1 physical (Proficiency) and are temporarily Vulnerable.

striking-serpent.name: Venomous Strike
striking-serpent.short: Attack any number of targets within Very Close range; hits are temporarily Poisoned (1d10 direct physical damage each time they act).

striking-serpent.name: Warning Hiss
striking-serpent.short: Mark a Stress to push any number of Melee-range targets back to Very Close range.

pouncing-predator.name: Fleet
pouncing-predator.short: Spend a Hope to move to Far range without rolling.

pouncing-predator.name: Takedown
pouncing-predator.short: Mark a Stress to close to Melee range and attack; on a hit, +2 Proficiency for this attack and the target marks a Stress.

winged-beast.name: Bird’s-Eye View
winged-beast.short: Fly at will. Once per rest while airborne, ask the GM a question about the scene below with no roll; the first roll made using that answer gets advantage.

great-predator.name: Carrier
great-predator.short: Carry up to two willing allies when you move.

great-predator.name: Vicious Maul
great-predator.short: On a hit, spend a Hope to make the target temporarily Vulnerable and get +1 Proficiency for this attack.

mighty-lizard.name: Snapping Strike
mighty-lizard.short: On a Melee hit, spend a Hope to clamp the target in your jaws, making them temporarily Restrained and Vulnerable.

great-winged-beast.name: Bird’s-Eye View
great-winged-beast.short: Fly at will. Once per rest while airborne, ask the GM a question about the scene below with no roll; the first roll made using that answer gets advantage.

great-winged-beast.name: Carrier
great-winged-beast.short: Carry up to two willing allies when you move.

aquatic-predator.name: Vicious Maul
aquatic-predator.short: On a hit, spend a Hope to make the target Vulnerable and get +1 Proficiency for this attack.

legendary-beast.name: Evolved
legendary-beast.short: Pick a Tier 1 Beastform and become a larger version of it, keeping its traits and features. Gain +6 to damage rolls, +1 to the form’s trait, and +2 Evasion.

legendary-hybrid.name: Hybrid Features
legendary-hybrid.short: Mark an additional Stress to transform. Choose two Beastform options from Tiers 1–2, taking four advantages and two features from them total.

massive-behemoth.name: Carrier
massive-behemoth.short: Carry up to four willing allies when you move.

massive-behemoth.name: Demolish
massive-behemoth.short: Spend a Hope to move to Far range in a line, attacking all targets within Melee range of it; hits deal d8+10 physical (Proficiency) and are temporarily Vulnerable.

terrible-lizard.name: Devastating Strikes
terrible-lizard.short: Deal Severe damage in Melee: mark a Stress to force an additional Hit Point marked.

terrible-lizard.name: Massive Stride
terrible-lizard.short: Move to Far range without rolling; ignore rough terrain (GM’s discretion) due to your size.

mythic-aerial-hunter.name: Carrier
mythic-aerial-hunter.short: Carry up to three willing allies when you move.

mythic-aerial-hunter.name: Deadly Raptor
mythic-aerial-hunter.short: Fly at will and move to Far range as part of your action. Flying a straight line from at least Close into Melee range of a target and attacking them in the same action: reroll damage dice that rolled below your Proficiency.

epic-aquatic-beast.name: Ocean Master
epic-aquatic-beast.short: Breathe and move naturally underwater. On a Melee hit, temporarily Restrain the target.

epic-aquatic-beast.name: Unyielding
epic-aquatic-beast.short: When you’d mark an Armor Slot, roll a d6: on a 5+, reduce the severity by one threshold instead, with no Armor Slot marked.

mythic-beast.name: Evolved
mythic-beast.short: Pick a Tier 1 or 2 Beastform and become a larger version of it, keeping its traits and features. Gain +9 to damage rolls, +2 to the form’s trait, +3 Evasion, and your damage die increases one size (d6→d8, d8→d10, etc.).

mythic-hybrid.name: Hybrid Features
mythic-hybrid.short: Mark 2 additional Stress to transform. Choose three Beastform options from Tiers 1–3, taking five advantages and three features from them total.
